name: SendIopReset
evidence: sends the IOP the reset command 0x80000003 with its argument in a packet by DMA and waits for the IOP to come back

name: IsIopResetDone
evidence: tells whether the IOP has come back from a reset, from a register shared with it (LoadIopModules polls it)

name: ResetIop
evidence: resets the IOP with "rom0:UDNL " followed by an argument of up to 69 characters after shutting the remote calls down (LoadIopModules resets it with the IOP image)

name: DisableInterrupts
evidence: original assembly: clears the status register's interrupt enable and returns whether it was set (the wrappers and the IOP clients bracket their critical sections with it)

name: EnableInterrupts
evidence: original assembly: sets the status register's interrupt enable again

name: CreateLibrarySemaphores
evidence: creates the two semaphores D_002771E4 and D_002771E8 (InitKernelLibrary calls it first)

name: FindKernelWord
evidence: returns the address of the first word equal to a value from 0x80000000 on

name: InstallKernelWordSearch
evidence: installs FindKernelWord as the system call D_002771D8 names (0x83)

name: InitKernelLibrary
evidence: runs the kernel library's set-ups: its semaphores, InstallKernelWordSearch, the three kernel patch installers and StartRequestThread (the program's entry func_00100008 calls it)
